label: Edge gateway
info:
Smart Kanban Bins edge gateway (gw01).

Modbus poll of six bins -> units, deadband, heartbeat, fault flags -> P-240 reorder rule -> store-and-forward -> MQTT 5 over TLS (EMQX Cloud).

Environment (from .env): MQTT_URL, MQTT_USER, MQTT_PASS, MODBUS_HOST, MODBUS_PORT.

name: Smart Kanban edge: simulator (Modbus TCP) -> units / P-240 -> MQTT 5 over TLS
info: See docs/register_map.md for the registers and docs/schema.md for the MQTT payloads.

name: Modbus poll (6 bins)
finalize:
const client = context.get('client');
if (client && client.isOpen) client.close(() => {});

name: Units, deadband, heartbeat, faults
P-240 reorder (hysteresis)
Store-and-forward
TLS: verify the server certificate (EMQX uses a public CA)
